124.description: These tokens represent common Hindi root words, prefixes, and grammatical suffixes.

191.description: This feature vector activates on sub-word and character sequences characteristic of Hindi and other Devanagari-script text.

64.description: This feature vector represents Devanagari script characters and common sub-word letter combinations used in Hindi typography.

76.description: This vector represents common Hindi verb roots and inflectional suffixes.

48.description: This vector represents common Hindi vowel sign suffixes and syllable combinations, particularly involving the 'aa' and 'i' vowel sounds.

118.description: This vector represents Devanagari consonant conjuncts and character combinations containing halant markers.

2.description: This feature vector represents common suffixes, prefixes, and common words in the Hindi language.

36.description: These tokens represent common Hindi words, grammatical particles, and morphemes extracted from a text corpus.

39.description: These tokens are Hindi nasalizing vowel signs and anusvara diacritics used in Devanagari script.

14.description: This vector activates on common Sanskrit and Hindi lexical prefixes, morphemes, and sub-word units starting with the consonant 'स' (sa).
